review.tagline: Multilingual speech recognition and translation model with Python and CLI interfaces
review.summary: Whisper is a Transformer sequence-to-sequence model for speech recognition, speech-to-English translation, and language identification. It ships as a pip package with a `whisper` command and a Python API, in six sizes from tiny (39M parameters) to large (1550M), plus a turbo variant. Code and weights are MIT licensed.
review.audience: Developers needing local speech-to-text or translation in Python or scripts
strengths: Six model sizes (39M to 1550M parameters) trade accuracy for speed and VRAM
Handles transcription, translation to English and language identification in one model
Simple `whisper audio.mp3 --model turbo` CLI and a short Python API
Code and weights both under MIT license
weaknesses: No built-in HTTP server or web UI; you wrap it yourself
The turbo model is not trained for translation and returns the original language
Requires ffmpeg, and possibly Rust for tiktoken if no prebuilt wheel exists
Accuracy varies widely by language; large model needs about 10 GB VRAM
needs: Needs ffmpeg, PyTorch, tiktoken, Rust (if no prebuilt tiktoken wheel)
Models: tiny, base, small, medium, large
